name: card_group_clear_counts
description: Group-clear event honesty (regression: the per-round member query reused stale trampoline staging left by the emit wrapper, so round 2 re-ran the emit body and produced a 5th CARD_REMOVED_FROM_DECK for a 4-copy row). One A press on the fully-decked first row clears exactly its owned copies: 4 removal events and the row reads DECK 0/4.
